architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. CSS modules for styling. React Router for navigation. Vite build tool. No state management library (use React context for global state).

tickets.title: Create customer home page (src/pages/CustomerHome.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React. Extract reusable components (ProductCard, Header, Footer). Preserve exact layout, colors, typography. Use CSS modules for styling.
acceptance_criteria: ProductCard component reusable for other pages

tickets.title: Create admin dashboard page (src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert admin dashboard HTML to React. Extract reusable components (StatsCard, Sidebar, DataTable). Preserve exact layout. Use CSS modules.

tickets.title: Create product detail page (src/pages/ProductDetail.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert product detail HTML to React. Extract OrderForm component. Preserve exact layout, form validation. Use CSS modules.
acceptance_criteria: OrderForm component reusable for other products

tickets.title: Create order history page (src/pages/OrderHistory.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert order history HTML to React. Extract OrderCard component. Preserve exact layout, status indicators. Use CSS modules.

tickets.title: Create authentication pages (src/pages/Login.jsx, src/pages/Register.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert auth HTML to React. Extract AuthForm component. Preserve exact layout, form validation. Use CSS modules.
acceptance_criteria: AuthForm component reusable for both pages

tickets.title: Create admin event management page (src/pages/AdminEventManagement.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert event management HTML to React. Extract EventForm, EventTable components. Preserve exact layout, CRUD functionality. Use CSS modules.

tickets.title: Create design system components (src/components/DesignSystem/)
tickets.description: Extract reusable components from design system screens. Create Button, Card, Badge, Table, Input components. Use CSS modules for styling. Document props in JSDoc.
acceptance_criteria: Components match Stitch design tokens exactly

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell with navigation bar. Set up React Router with routes for all pages. Implement auth-protected routes. Use CSS modules for styling.
